source: The Sound Picker's picks/round-12 document, version 17 (final), as saved. Snow: option a, all three takes. Crystal: "now", the glass shatter, its takes 1 and 3 dropped, so BreakCrystal plays its own copy of the glass's second take. Bone: option c (Bone rattle), its takes 1 and 3 dropped, so its second take ships alone. Stone: option a (Hard crack and crumbs), all three takes; they ship as world/break-stone-crack-<n>.wav, because three enemy scenes (crystal-colossus, shardback, watcher-eye) play the round-5 stone files by path and keep them. Ice: "now" without its first take. Wood: "now" without its first take (the quiet one). Soft: "now", its second take alone. For ice, wood and soft the takes are the round-5 files as they are: only the players' randomizers change, and a dropped file is deleted only where no enemy scene plays it (wood's first; ice's first and soft's first and third stay for the enemies).
